# omada_switch_port (Resource)

Configuration of an existing physical port on an Omada-managed switch. Removing this resource only stops Terraform management; it does not reset the live port.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manages the configuration of an existing physical port. It does not create
# or delete a port: removing this resource only stops Terraform management.
resource "omada_switch_port" "camera_entrance" {
  switch_mac = "D8-44-89-38-C6-C0"
  port       = 2

  name              = "CAMERA MAIN FLOOR - ENTRANCE"
  profile_id        = "6a9ef808c7e1e27192728693"
  native_network_id = "6a9ef808c7e1e2719272868b"

  # 0 = Allow All, 1 = Block All. Custom VLAN membership is configured by
  # assigning a profile_id; its value can still be observed during refresh.
  network_tags_setting = 1
  link_speed           = 0 # Auto
  duplex               = 0 # Auto
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) Physical port number printed by the switch, starting at 1.
- `switch_mac` (String) MAC address of the managed switch, using either colon or dash separators.

### Optional

- `duplex` (Number) Duplex enum: 0 Auto, 1 Half, 2 Full.
- `link_speed` (Number) Controller link-speed enum, where 0 is Auto. Other supported values depend on the switch model.
- `name` (String) Port display name.
- `native_network_id` (String) ID of the untagged/native VLAN network.
- `network_tags_setting` (Number) VLAN tag policy: 0 Allow All or 1 Block All. Custom (2) can be read from the controller but must be configured through profile_id because the safe port PATCH does not accept tagged-network lists.
- `profile_id` (String) ID of the switch LAN/port profile assigned to the port.
- `profile_override_enable` (Boolean) Whether profile-level port settings are overridden.
- `profile_vlan_override_enable` (Boolean) Whether the profile VLAN settings are overridden.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) Controller tag IDs applied to the port (these are labels, not VLAN IDs).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Ports are imported as "<site>:<switch_mac>:<port>", where <site> is either
# the site ID or the site name. Use the controller's dash-separated MAC form.
terraform import omada_switch_port.camera_entrance Default:D8-44-89-38-C6-C0:2
```
